1. (Currently amended) A method of analyzing one or more plant embryos comprising: (a) collecting shed cellular material from one or more embryos by agitating the one or more embryos in a non-destructive medium __consisting essentially of water__; (b) obtaining DNA from the shed cellular material __by exposing the shed cellular material to cold and then heat followed by agitation__; (c) performing a molecular analysis of the DNA obtained in step (b), __wherein said molecular analysis is genotyping__; and (d) germinating at least one of said one or more embryos __after step (c)__.

2. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the non-destructive medium consists essentially of water.

3. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the DNA is obtained by exposing the shed cellular material to cold and then heat followed by agitation.

4. (Currently amended) The method of claim 3 wherein said cold, heat, and agitation steps are repeated.

5. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the DNA is obtained by [[exposing the shed cellular material to]] heat [[followed by]] __and__ agitation.

6. (Currently amended) The method of claim 5 wherein said heat and agitation steps are repeated.

7. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein DNA is obtained by incubating the shed cellular material with an enzyme __comprising VISCOZYME®__.

8. (Currently amended) The method of claim 7 wherein the enzyme is VISCOZYME®.

9. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein obtaining DNA from the shed cellular material comprises extracting the DNA __by adding magnetic particles to the shed cellular material__.

10. (Currently amended) The method of claim 9, wherein said extracting is performed by adding magnetic particles to the shed cellular material.

11. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the one or more embryos comprise one or more immature embryos __stored prior to step (c) or (d)__.

12. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 further comprising storing the one or more embryos prior to step (c) or (d).

13. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, wherein said molecular analysis is genotyping __by way of single nucleotide polymorphism detection, restriction fragment length polymorphism identification, random amplified polymorphic detection, amplified fragment length polymorphism detection, DNA sequencing, whole genome sequencing, allele specific oligonucleotide probes, or DNA hybridization to DNA microarrays or beads__.

14. (Currently amended) The method of claim 13, wherein said genotyping occurs by way of: single nucleotide polymorphism detection, restriction fragment length polymorphism identification, random amplified polymorphic detection, amplified fragment length polymorphism detection, DNA sequencing, whole genome sequencing, allele specific oligonucleotide probes, or DNA hybridization to DNA microarrays or beads.

15. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 further comprising growing a germinated embryo into a plant and phenotyping the plant.

16. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein prior to said molecular analysis, whole genome amplification is performed.

17. (Currently amended) The method of claim 13 further comprising selecting one or more embryos based on genotype __and storing the selected one or more embryos prior to germinating__.

18. (Currently amended) The method of claim 17 further comprising germinating the one or more selected embryos __after said selecting__.

19. (Currently amended) The method of claim 18 wherein any of the steps resulting in selection of one or more embryos is automated.
